technical.summary: Short-term momentum (RSI-9, Supertrend, OBV) shows bullish signals but price remains below key moving averages (EMA-21, EMA-50, SMA-200) with weak trend strength (ADX 20.97), creating conflicting signals unsuitable for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: IQV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 50 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 12) combined with significant congressional buying (Schrader $250k-$500k purchase Jan 2022) presents contrarian opportunity despite bearish AAII sentiment (53.5%), though lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (356.16) with flat yield curve, imminent NFP event in 2 days, and earnings in 50 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for IQV positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI-9 bullish/rising, Supertrend, OBV rising, positive CMF) combined with extreme contrarian fear conditions and congressional buying conviction suggest capitulation bottom setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages (EMA-21/50, SMA-50/200), weak trend strength (ADX 20.97), macro crisis regime (VIX 356.16), imminent NFP catalyst, high earnings risk, and zero smart money/insider conviction create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum signals (RSI-9, Supertrend, OBV) show early bullish structure, and extreme fear conditions present contrarian opportunity. However, price remains structurally trapped below all major moving averages with weak trend confirmation (ADX 20.97), making this unsuitable for swing entry at current levels.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis regime (VIX 356.16) combined with imminent NFP catalyst in 2 days and earnings in 50 days creates unacceptable event risk; price could break lower through support before momentum confirms.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias despite contrarian sentiment signals
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding IQV with 37 existing Health Care positions (11% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing position reduce conviction further; skip entry and monitor for clearer technical setup above EMA-21.
